parsedReview.oneParagraphVerdict: This is a strong opening chapter with clean layering, memorable mechanism lines, and unusually honest limits around uncertainty and emergency tempo. I would not ship it against a strict professional >=80 bar yet because the quiz answers are often guessable from giveaway phrasing, and transfer leans too heavily on HopeLab/Intel/product-review variants rather than showing the move travel into more distinct real contexts. No must-fix reserved-category defect appears on the page, but the chapter needs stronger distractors and a few richer transfer examples before it feels professionally finished.
